verdict.rationale: Kling offers automation-adjacent features: editable nodes, agent workflows, batch production, and MCP/CLI access. None of the evidence shows versioning, review, or rollback of automations. "Generate multiple versions" refers to variants of creative output, not to versioned workflows, and node editing is a different capability from version history or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
